Wvlet Maven Repository

Every release of the Wvlet projects is published here. Maven Central gets some of these releases, with the same files and signatures.

Repository URL: https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2

Projects

ProjectGroup IDLatest version here
uni org.wvlet.uni see maven-metadata.xml

Add the repository

You only need this repository for versions that are not on Maven Central yet. Keep Maven Central in your build as well.

sbt

// build.sbt
resolvers += "wvlet" at "https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2"

// project/plugins.sbt, for an sbt plugin version that is not on Maven Central yet
resolvers += "wvlet" at "https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2"

scala-cli

//> using repository https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2

Mill

def repositories = super.repositories() ++ Seq("https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2")

Gradle (Kotlin DSL)

repositories {
    mavenCentral()
    maven("https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2")
}

Maven

<repositories>
  <repository>
    <id>wvlet</id>
    <url>https://repo.wvlet.org/maven2</url>
  </repository>
</repositories>

Notes

  • If you publish a library to Maven Central, depend on versions that are on Maven Central and don't add this repository to its build. Your users then need no extra repository.
  • Folders can't be browsed here, but every file is served at its usual Maven path, for example org/wvlet/uni/uni_3/maven-metadata.xml.
  • Artifacts are signed with the same PGP key as the releases on Maven Central.
